project.name: LEAPS Accounting Fix
project.description: Correct the LEAPS carve-out backtest so portfolio NAV reflects true mark-to-market of live contracts at every date, with no lookahead, behind a test suite that encodes no-lookahead, conserved accounting, and output plausibility.
project.overview: Fixes four defects diagnosed in plans/leaps_debug.md: (1 primary) _live_contracts builds its rolled-out exclusion set with no date bound, producing lookahead (day-1 NAV understated to ~$600k on a $1M start, terminal 5-10x spike); (2) vol_prices column lookup uses a literal '^VIX' key while build_price_data keys columns by asset ticker, so dynamic IV never engages; (3) splice raises when end_date < splice_date; (4) no integration test exercises the LEAPS lifecycle and the real-data smoke test reads wrong parquet column names ('IRX'/'VIX' vs actual '^IRX'/'^VIX'). The fix lands the critical date filter in isolation (Phase 1a), validates it under constant IV (Phase 2), then layers the secondary dynamic-IV activation (Phase 4) so the two behavior changes are never conflated. Binding contract translated from plans/leaps_debug_plan.md.

testing.mutation_rationale: Plan section 2 scopes testing to pytest + hypothesis only; mutmut is intentionally excluded from this fix's design. Per plan-to-spec override, the spec matches the plan.

data_schemas.name: LeapsRollEvent
data_schemas.description: Existing frozen dataclass (leverage.py:124). roll_date is the date oracle the primary fix filters _live_contracts on. No schema change; listed as the contract the fix honors.

fields.name: roll_date
fields.description: pd.Timestamp the roll executed. The temporal oracle for the roll-guard filter (event.roll_date <= current_date).

fields.name: old_contract
fields.description: LeapsContract closed at the roll; the element added to the rolled_out exclusion set.

fields.name: new_contract
fields.description: Replacement LeapsContract with purchase_date == roll_date; becomes live on the roll date under the <= boundary.

data_schemas.name: LeapsGttCloseEvent
data_schemas.description: Existing frozen dataclass (leverage.py:166). close_date is the intended, genuine date oracle for the gtt-close guard (Phase 1b).

fields.name: close_date
fields.description: pd.Timestamp of the forced full close. Genuine (not synthetic); safe for a close_date <= current_date guard.

fields.name: contract
fields.description: LeapsContract fully closed; element added to the gtt_closed exclusion set.

data_schemas.name: LeapsPartialCloseEvent
data_schemas.description: Existing frozen dataclass (leverage.py:145). WARNING: when frozen onto the ledger at the return boundary (portfolio.py:809) close_date is set to a SYNTHETIC final_date, not the true partial-close date. A naive close_date <= current_date guard therefore reverts to the full-size original at any date < final_date. Governs the Phase 1b trap.

fields.name: close_date
fields.description: pd.Timestamp of the partial close. Synthetic (== final_date) as populated by run_backtest's freeze step; do NOT treat as the true close date without threading real dates through the freeze.

fields.name: original_contract
fields.description: LeapsContract before reduction; key of the partially_closed substitution map.

fields.name: continuation_contract
fields.description: Same contract with reduced n_contracts; the value substituted for the original in the live set.

data_schemas.name: PriceData
data_schemas.description: Existing frozen dataclass (data.py:16). vol_prices columns are keyed by ASSET TICKER (e.g. 'VTI'), NOT by vol-index ticker ('^VIX'). This convention is authoritative; the Fix-2 lookup and the test fixture must honor it.

fields.name: vol_prices
fields.description: DatetimeIndex x asset-ticker columns of implied-vol series (decimal). Empty DataFrame when vol indices not fetched. Fix 2 must look up by the LEAPS underlying ticker, not a literal '^VIX'.

fields.name: prices
fields.description: DatetimeIndex x asset-ticker adjusted-close prices; underlying spot source for LEAPS MTM.

api_contracts.name: _live_contracts
api_contracts.description: Pure function returning live LeapsContracts at current_date (leverage.py:589). PRIMARY FIX target. Must become a pure function of events with event_date <= current_date: rolled_out, gtt_closed, and the partially_closed substitution map all filtered by date. Signature unchanged.

inputs.name: ledger
inputs.description: Full contract + event history (per-window during the backtest loop; merged post-loop).

inputs.name: current_date
inputs.description: Valuation date T. No returned field may depend on any event dated > T.

outputs.name: live
outputs.description: Contracts purchased on/before T, not expired, not rolled out as of T, not gtt-closed as of T, substituted by continuation if partially closed as of T.

api_contracts.name: run_backtest (vol_prices dynamic-IV lookup)
api_contracts.description: Fix 2 (portfolio.py:555). Replace the literal '^VIX' membership/lookup with the LEAPS `underlying` variable already in scope (portfolio.py:544), so VIX-dynamic IV engages when vol_prices carries the underlying's column. Activation isolated to Phase 4. Signature unchanged.

inputs.name: price_data.vol_prices
inputs.description: Asset-ticker-keyed IV series; presence of the underlying's column toggles dynamic IV.

inputs.name: underlying
inputs.description: LEAPS underlying ticker derived from the *_LEAPS key; the correct column key.

outputs.name: mtm_iv_series
outputs.description: VIX_MTM_WINDOW rolling-mean IV for daily MTM, floored at config.leaps_config.iv; None (constant IV) when the underlying column is absent.

api_contracts.name: build_price_data (splice-eligibility guard)
api_contracts.description: Fix 3 (data.py:292). Tighten the splice-eligibility test to `start_date < splice_date <= end_date` so a window ending before a ticker's splice date fetches the primary as-is instead of calling splice() with an empty post slice. I/O boundary; splice() retains its own ValueError as last-line defense.

inputs.name: end_date
inputs.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). New bound: splice only attempted when splice_date <= end_date.

outputs.name: price_data
outputs.description: Primary-only prices when end_date < splice_date; spliced prices when the window straddles splice_date.

features.name: Roll-guard date-awareness (primary fix)
features.description: Apply ONLY the event.roll_date <= current_date filter to the rolled_out set in _live_contracts (leverage.py:603). This is the entire cause of the day-1 and terminal symptoms. Ship in isolation; do not bundle the gtt/partial guards.

invariants.temporal_bounds: live(ledger, T) = f(roll_events with roll_date <= T); no dependence on any roll_event dated > T (INV-1).
invariants.accounting_oracle: roll_contract net-proceeds continuity: old excluded and new (purchase_date==roll_date) live at T => no gap, no double-count.
invariants.realism_requirements: Multi-roll ledger; same-day roll boundary must be exercised.

performance_requirements.notes: R = number of roll_events; one filtered set comprehension per call, no added asymptotic cost over the existing unfiltered comprehension.

invariants: Live set at T invariant to appending any roll_event dated > T (validated in F-2B).

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Plan section 2 scopes testing to pytest + hypothesis; mutmut excluded by design.

acceptance_criteria: A contract purchased at t0 with a roll_event dated t2 IS present in _live_contracts(ledger, t1) for t0 < t1 < t2 (pre-fix: absent).
The same contract is NOT present in _live_contracts(ledger, t3) for t3 > t2, and its replacement (purchase_date == t2) IS present at exactly t2 (same-day boundary, <= semantics).
tests/test_leverage.py, tests/test_gtt_leaps_close.py, tests/test_portfolio.py all pass unchanged before and after the edit.

Full-suite before/after run confirming no existing test regresses.

Merged multi-window ledger (GTT): roll_events from multiple windows coexist; dates globally monotonic so the filter remains correct.

invariants.realism_requirements: Ledger with gtt-close and partial-close events dated before the query date.

performance_requirements.notes: G gtt-close + P partial-close events; two date-filtered comprehensions, no added asymptotic cost.
